system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Define one complete robotics scenario named DuctInspectTouchF for the free-base aerial robot domain. Mission: Approach a vertical inspection surface, establish a bounded normal probe force, and hold contact for the last quarter of the run. Embodiment: A 2.7 kg cylindrical body carries four protected ducted fans and a compliant 0.18 m inspection probe along body X. Actuation: Four fan thrust channels and one probe-force actuator are bounded, and do not exceed 22 N-per-fan. Observation: IMU, lidar, optical flow, and probe force sensing estimate pose and contact. Operating context: Represent the wall as a fixed collidable box with friction coefficient 0.55. Control: use position-to-impedance hybrid control. Robustness case: apply a controlled 4.35 N tangential wind disturbance during the middle third. Timing and evidence: Run at 500 Hz for 20 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Verification criteria: Require thrust and attitude bounds, approach speed, contact force between 5 N and 14 N, and no fan collision, primary tracking error below 0.032 m stand-off after 13 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
